newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Ambassador Gheorghe Petre, Romania's special envoy to Lima, condemned the terrorist act in Lima in the Japanese ambassador's residence in which hundreds of hostages, including Romania's commercial attache, are held by left-wing rebels.
* The Romanian Petrol Company intends to increase oil product prices following the rise of the prices of imported crude and the present leu-dollar exchange rate.
The refineries, which currently register losses worth 70 billion lei ($18.4 million) a month, propose a price rise in refined oil from the present 680 lei (18 cents) to 1,000 lei (26 cent) a litre.
* President Emil Constantinescu appointed Nicu Anghel as the new head of the Special Protection Service (SPP) for high officials.
* Parliament started a joint session to name the members of Romania's delegations to various international organisations and to appoint the new interim chairman of the state television.
* The lower Chamber of Deputies voted to allow the government to rule by decree during parliament's recess.

* The Romanian National Unity Party protests over the inclusion of the Hungarian Democratic Union (UDMR) in the governing coalition and the appointment of UDMR prefects in some counties in Transylvania.
